name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
short_description: Income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families across India.
description: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a flagship Central Sector Scheme with 100% funding from Government of India. The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹6,000 per annum to all landholding farmer families having cultivable land, subject to specified exclusion criteria. The amount is directly credited to bank accounts of beneficiaries through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode every four months (₹2,000 each installment).
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
eligibility: All landholding farmer families having cultivable landholdings in their names are eligible. Exclusions: Institutional landholders, farmer families holding constitutional posts, serving or retired government officers/employees, pensioners with monthly pension of ₹10,000 or more, income tax payers in the last assessment year, and registered professionals (doctors, engineers, lawyers, CAs).
benefits: ₹6,000 per annum transferred directly into the bank accounts of eligible farmer families in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each every 4 months.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land ownership papers (RoR/Khatoni), Bank account details linked to Aadhaar, Active mobile number for OTP eKYC verification.
how_to_apply: Farmers can register online at pmkisan.gov.in under 'Farmers Corner -> New Farmer Registration' or through local Common Service Centres (CSCs) and State Nodal Officers.
source_name: myScheme / Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
short_description: Comprehensive, low-premium crop insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks, pests, and post-harvest losses.
description: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) provides comprehensive crop insurance covering yield loss, prevented sowing, localized calamities, post-harvest losses, and mid-season adversity for notified food, oilseed, and commercial/horticultural crops. Farmers pay very low subsidized uniform premiums (2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial crops) with the remaining premium heavily shared by Central and State Governments.
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers, are eligible for coverage. Participation is voluntary for all farmers.
benefits: Full financial protection against crop failure due to drought, dry spells, flood, inundation, pests & diseases, landslide, natural fire, and post-harvest cyclone damage with rapid claim settlements directly into bank accounts.
documents_required: Land ownership document (RoR/Record of Rights), Sowing certificate issued by local revenue/agriculture officer or tenancy agreement, Aadhaar card, Bank passbook copy.
how_to_apply: Apply through the National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in), commercial/cooperative banks, CSC centres, or authorized insurance agents before the cutoff date for the crop season.
source_name: myScheme / Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
short_description: Concessional, flexible institutional credit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% effective interest rate for agricultural cultivation and allied operations.
description: The Kisan Credit Card (KCC) scheme simplifies credit access for farmers to meet short-term cultivation expenses, post-harvest requirements, produce marketing loans, consumption requirements of farmer households, and investment credit for agricultural assets. Under the Interest Subvention Scheme, farmers get loans up to ₹3,00,000 at 7% p.a., with a 3% prompt repayment incentive bringing the effective interest down to 4% p.a.
department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / Department of Financial Services
eligibility: All farmers (individual/joint borrowers), owner-cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and Self Help Groups (SHGs) or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers. Includes dairy and fisheries farmers.
benefits: Short-term credit limit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% effective interest with timely repayment. Collateral-free loan limit up to ₹1.60 lakh. ATM-enabled RuPay debit card for convenient cash withdrawals.
documents_required: Simplified one-page KCC application form, Aadhaar Card / Voter ID, Address proof, Land record title documents (7/12, Khatoni), Passport photograph.
how_to_apply: Submit application form at any branch of Commercial Banks, Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), Cooperative Banks, or apply online through the PM-KISAN portal single-page KCC link.

name: Soil Health Card (SHC) Scheme
short_description: Periodic soil nutrient analysis and customized crop-specific fertilizer and micronutrient advisory for all agricultural lands.
description: The Soil Health Card Scheme assists farmers in assessing the physical and chemical fertility status of their soil every 3 years. It provides precise customized recommendations on macro-nutrients (N, P, K), secondary nutrients (S), micronutrients (Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo), and physical parameters (pH, EC, Organic Carbon) to optimize crop yields and prevent soil degradation from over-fertilization.
eligibility: All farmers owning or cultivating agricultural land in India.
benefits: Free soil test report card containing 12 key soil health parameters and tailored organic and chemical fertilizer dosage advice, lowering fertilizer costs by 8-10% and improving yield by 5-6%.
documents_required: Land record details (Khata/Khasra/Survey number), Farmer identity details (Aadhaar number and village name).
how_to_apply: Soil samples are collected GPS-tagged by Village Nodal Officers, or farmers can take soil samples directly to the nearest Soil Testing Laboratory (STL) or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK).
source_name: myScheme / Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: PM-KUSUM (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan)
short_description: Up to 60% capital subsidy for installing standalone solar agriculture pumps and solarizing grid-connected irrigation pump sets.
description: PM-KUSUM enables farmers, farmer groups, and cooperatives to install solar-powered agricultural water pumps and solarize existing grid-connected electric and diesel pumps. It provides clean, reliable daytime irrigation energy while allowing farmers to sell surplus generated solar power back to the grid for secondary income.
department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
eligibility: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, FPOs, cooperatives, and panchayats having agricultural land with irrigation water availability.
benefits: 60% subsidy on installation of solar pumps (30% Central Government + 30% State Government subsidy). The farmer contributes only 10% upfront, with bank loans covering the remaining 30%. Eliminates costly diesel expenses.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land ownership documents (7/12, Khatoni), Bank account passbook, Electricity bill of existing connection (for grid-solarization component).
how_to_apply: Apply through the respective State Nodal Agency (SNA) portal or the national PM-KUSUM portal (pmkusum.mnre.gov.in). Beware of fraudulent fake websites.
source_name: myScheme / Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
short_description: Pan-India electronic trading portal connecting wholesale agricultural mandis for transparent price discovery and direct farmer payment.
description: e-NAM is an innovative electronic trading portal that networks the existing physical APMC wholesale mandis into a unified national market for agricultural commodities. It removes information asymmetry between buyers and sellers, ensures transparent competitive online bidding, promotes quality testing and assaying, and provides direct online payment into farmers' bank accounts.
eligibility: Any farmer, FPO, or trader wishing to buy or sell agricultural commodities transparently through electronic auctions across integrated APMCs.
benefits: Access to a national marketplace of 1,360+ mandis, transparent bidding, automated weighing, digital electronic assaying reports, and fast electronic settlement into bank accounts without intermediary exploitation.
documents_required: Aadhaar card, Bank account details (passbook / cancelled cheque with IFSC), APMC gate registration pass.
how_to_apply: Register online at enam.gov.in (Registration -> Farmer) or visit the e-NAM facilitation desk at any integrated APMC market yard.

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
short_description: Financial support of ₹50,000/ha for adopting chemical-free organic farming in clusters with free PGS-India organic certification.
description: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) promotes traditional and organic farming practices using indigenous resources and village-level organic inputs. Farmers form clusters of 20 or more farmers across 20 hectares (50 acres) to convert to chemical-free agriculture, receiving funding for organic inputs, capacity building, and PGS-India certification.
eligibility: Farmers willing to transition to organic farming in a registered cluster of at least 20 members covering 20 or more contiguous hectares.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare for 3 years (including ₹31,000/ha direct financial assistance via DBT for bio-fertilizers, vermicompost, botanical extracts, and organic seeds) plus free PGS-India organic certification.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card, Land ownership/cultivation documents, Bank passbook, Cluster registration / group endorsement form.
how_to_apply: Contact the District Agriculture Officer (DAO) or Regional Council of PGS-India to join an existing or register a new organic farming cluster.
source_name: myScheme / National Centre of Organic and Natural Farming

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
short_description: Medium-to-long term debt financing with 3% interest subvention for post-harvest management and community farming assets.
description: The Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF) is a dedicated financing facility providing ₹1 Lakh Crore in bank loans for building viable post-harvest management projects (cold storages, warehouses, sorting/grading units, packhouses) and community farming assets (custom hiring centres, smart farming machinery).
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, PACS, Marketing Cooperative Societies, SHGs, Joint Liability Groups, and Agri-entrepreneurs setting up post-harvest agricultural infrastructure.
benefits: 3% per annum interest subvention on loans up to ₹2 Crores for up to 7 years. CGTMSE credit guarantee fee coverage borne by Government without demanding third-party collateral.
documents_required: Detailed Project Report (DPR), Land revenue records or registered lease deed, Bank statements (last 6 months), PAN Card, Aadhaar Card.
how_to_apply: Submit project proposal directly on the online portal agriinfra.dac.gov.in for pre-approval and routing to chosen lending bank.
source_name: myScheme / Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop (PDMC)
short_description: Up to 55% capital subsidy for drip and sprinkler micro-irrigation systems to improve water use efficiency and crop yield.
description: Per Drop More Crop (PDMC) is a key pillar of PMKSY focusing on water-use efficiency at farm level through precision micro-irrigation technologies (drip, micro-sprinklers, rain guns). It optimizes water availability, lowers weed growth and electricity consumption, and enhances crop productivity.
eligibility: All landholding farmers with an assured water source on their farm (well, tubewell, farm pond, canal lift).
benefits: Capital subsidy of 55% for Small & Marginal farmers and 45% for other farmers on the benchmark cost of drip and sprinkler irrigation installations.
documents_required: Land ownership document (RoR / 7-12 / Khata), Aadhaar Card, Bank passbook copy, Water source verification.
how_to_apply: Apply through the State Horticulture or Agriculture portal (e.g., GGRC in Gujarat, e-Horticulture in other states) or visit the District Horticulture Officer.
source_name: myScheme / Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana - RKVY-RAFTAAR
short_description: Innovation and agri-entrepreneurship grants up to ₹25 Lakhs for ideation, incubation, and scaling of agriculture startups.
description: RKVY-RAFTAAR focuses on infrastructure development, agribusiness incubation, and agri-entrepreneurship. It provides direct grants-in-aid to early-stage innovators and startups solving agricultural bottlenecks in crop production, farm mechanization, supply chain, and precision farming.
eligibility: Farmers, students, rural youth, and registered startups with innovative tech or process solutions in agriculture and allied domains.
benefits: Pre-seed idea grant up to ₹5 Lakhs (Idea to Prototype) and seed stage grant up to ₹25 Lakhs with 2 months incubation mentorship and laboratory support.
documents_required: Project proposal / pitch deck, Identity and address proof, Entity registration certificate (if incorporated), Bank account details.
how_to_apply: Apply online through designated R-ABI (RKVY Agribusiness Incubator) portals (such as Pusa Krishi, MANAGE Hyderabad, CCSHAU Hisar) during active application cohorts.
source_name: myScheme / Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Mission Organic Value Chain Development for North Eastern Region (MOVCDNER)
short_description: End-to-end organic farming, processing, certification, and brand building support for farmers in North Eastern states.
description: MOVCDNER is a dedicated Central Sector Scheme aimed at developing certified organic production in value chain mode across the 8 North Eastern States of India (Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura). It links organic growers directly to processing companies and premium domestic/export markets.
department: Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region & MoA&FW
eligibility: Organic farmers and Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs) in the 8 North Eastern states.
benefits: Assistance up to ₹25,000/ha for organic inputs, seeds, and planting material; full organic certification coverage; subsidies up to 75% for cold storage, processing, and packhouse facilities.
documents_required: Land possession certificate, FPO membership card, Aadhaar Card, Bank account passbook.
how_to_apply: Apply through the State Organic Mission Lead Agency or District Agriculture Office in respective North-Eastern states.
source_name: myScheme / Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana (MKSY)
short_description: Zero-premium natural disaster crop relief assistance up to ₹25,000/ha for Kharif crop losses exceeding 33% across Gujarat.
description: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana is a 100% state-funded disaster compensation scheme by the Government of Gujarat. In the event of severe drought, excess unseasonal rainfall, or heavy flood resulting in 33% or more crop damage during the Kharif season, farmers receive direct compensation without paying any insurance premium.
department: Department of Agriculture, Farmers Welfare & Co-operation, Government of Gujarat
eligibility: All landholding farmers in Gujarat cultivating crops in the Kharif season who have suffered 33% or higher crop damage due to notified weather calamities.
benefits: Direct financial aid: ₹20,000 per hectare for crop loss between 33% and 60%, and ₹25,000 per hectare for loss exceeding 60%, up to a maximum limit of 4 hectares.
documents_required: 7/12 & 8-A land ownership records, Aadhaar Card, Sowing declaration or Talati certification, Bank passbook IFSC copy.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the iKhedut portal (ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in) through Village Computer Entrepreneurs (VCE) at Gram Panchayat eGram centres.
